newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PCI surges after two million share cross.
newsitem.headline: PCI surges after two million share cross.

text.p: Shares in printed circuit-board maker PCI Ltd surged 17 percent, or 13.5 cents, to a high of 93 Singapore cents on Tuesday morning after an off-market cross of two million shares in the company at 80 cents each.
By 0300 GMT, PCI shares had slipped back to 89.5 cents with just over three million traded.
"I think it's just a speculative play," said one dealer. "Of course, there are the usual takeover rumours, but every time the stock gets above 89.5 cents, it gets sold back down again."
Dealers said there was no indication who the parties involved in the cross were, or why it was priced below the market.
